channels.name: Michael Kitces
channels.description: Head of Planning Strategy at Focus Partners Wealth, co-founder of XY Planning Network and AdvicePay, publisher of Nerd's Eye View. Hosts the Financial Advisor Success podcast on this channel — hundreds of detailed interviews with independent advisors on building their practice.
channels.verificationMethod: Fetched the channel page directly, confirmed canonical ID and keywords. Exactly matches the founder's #1 candidate — one of the richest global niches found in this research so far.

blogs.name: Nerd's Eye View (Kitces.com)
blogs.verificationMethod: Exact feed URL confirmed directly from Kitces' own blog announcement post about the feed migration, plus independently corroborated across 3 separate FeedSpot directories. The dominant blog in the independent financial advisory space — voted #1 by a Zywave survey of advisor blogs.

notes: Matches the founder's own honest finding: nine professions in a row now with no Nigeria/Africa business-of-practice content — Nigeria's version of this profession is dominated by SEC licensing and institutional firms, no independent-advisor content movement. On books: the founder's 3 candidates (2 Carl Richards titles, the Olsen/Kitces annuities book) are all paid-only; one alternative found ('Guerrilla Marketing For Financial Advisors') only offers 3 free sample chapters, not the complete book, so wasn't counted — a partial teaser isn't the same as a free book.
